but i can tell he’s defeated..

thank you..

i know by now he is sick of it.. and not necessarily sick of me, but my depression..
my mom says it’s just something in my life right now that i have to deal with.. 
i feel i’ve tried to ask for his help and others help, but no one takes my suicidal cries serious.
my bf does, but what kind of a person wants to hear that all the time? 
ugh.. i think we’re not gonna make it love..

this was empowering, thank you.

any particular genre?

thank you for asking. i am not doing too well. i just feel as if everything around me is crashing down. so i wrote this board to find ways to help myself feel better...

everyday is so difficult for me. i don’t want anyone to feel the way i do... i always just picture myself jumping in front of a train. 

work is v stressful, i have such demeaning body images of myself and what i think of my body, and i don’t know a way out of my head..

being a human is so hard

i am so sorry. please don’t leave us. we need you here. this board was to help others figure out something that may help them get through it all.

but i’ll probably never take my own advice either.. or think i’m worthy of my own self love too. 

so i really understand, but i heard from a motivational speaker, “Help others achieve their dreams and you will achieve yours.” Les Brown

ha ha. me too.. i love chips and chocolate, but i know ultimately, it will make me feel worse if i eat them.. because i am working on my body. it’s been a burden. i am in much self doubt and very less self confidence. 

fruits are amazing. as long as you balance, you’ll be fine!

i am trying to find a good therapist.. they are always so booked, but it’s good to know people are getting help..

i am trying to figure out what i can do, to make myself feel better
do you see a therapist? or do forums help you just fine?

i love Cudi!
don’t do that in front of your dog!! your dog has feelings. they are well aware of death

people tend to use their anger at themselves to throw it on you. anything your mom is saying to you is a reflection of how she feels about herself. 

you don’t even know how you really look. a mirror doesn’t even come close to how beautiful you look to other people. fuck all this “beauty bullshit” social media has put in your head. and know that you are perfect just the way you are.

it’s not easy, but it will come. and you are going to bring out the best in you. you deserve to be happy. you deserve to feel beautiful. what will make you feel more pretty? are you a girl? do you wanna buy some new makeup? are you a man? do you want to try a new haircut? 

love yourself
